purpose: slide-indexed evidence pack for the 2026-08-19 interview deck

repaired_2m_dense_2d.blend: learned dense soft gate, 3 seeds averaged

repaired_2m_equal_2d.blend: fixed equal average, no learned parameters

accuracy.comparison: same molecules, same accepted ETKDGv3+MMFF200 rows

transferability.non_compliance_reason: Encoders were warm-started from PubChemQC checkpoints rather than trained from scratch on official PCQM4Mv2 data, and test-dev was never submitted. The number positions the architecture; it is not a rank.

geometry_leverage.question: how much accuracy is left on the table by ETKDG geometries
geometry_leverage.interpretation: Averaging removes ETKDG's random conformer noise but not its systematic offset from a relaxed geometry: only about a fifth of the geometry gap is reachable by sampling more conformers. Geometry quality was never disproven as a lever, which is why the 3D direction is paused rather than closed.
geometry_leverage.scope_caveat: measured on the QM9 architecture screen, not on PubChemQC

rejected_paths.why_closed: All three paired seeds regressed: average MAE +0.005456 eV versus the paired 500K control, seed std 0.000121 eV
Passed the internal exact-2M gate but failed fixed external retention: common +0.00482/+0.00570 eV, P8-hard +0.01187/+0.01481 eV

rejected_paths.path: pre-dispatch hard Router over the three GPS experts
rejected_paths.why_closed: Collapsed to GPS9 on every molecule, used GPS7 only for part of the LUMO target, and never selected GPS11-160, so it delivered neither specialization nor compute savings

rejected_paths.path: bounded dual-SchNet residual head on the frozen 2D identity
rejected_paths.why_closed: Its internal gate passed, but on the same external molecules it regressed against its own 2D base by +0.023251 eV (equal) and +0.024239 eV (dense); the SchNet encoders remain accepted assets, only this coupling is rejected

experimental_offset.quantity_referenced: thin-film / solution CV and UPS literature values
experimental_offset.why_not_comparable: Kohn-Sham eigenvalues are not quasiparticle levels, and a gas-phase calculation is not a condensed-phase measurement. Polarization, packing, and the measurement technique all shift the reference. A large offset is expected; only its size and consistency are informative.

public_path_consistency.note: The accepted table was produced under CUDA autocast; the public path runs fp32, so per-row differences are expected and only aggregate average MAE is gated.

smoke_test.note: Out-of-domain rows still return finite predictions; the loader reports applicability rather than refusing them. Do not present an out-of-domain value as a calibrated prediction.

claim_boundaries: Targets are gas-phase B3LYP/6-31G* Kohn-Sham eigenvalues, not experimental values and not GW.
Training covered CHONSFCl at MW 200-1000; anything outside is extrapolation.
Delta and uncertainty are calibrated to the previous v3 base, not to the recommended model.
The PCQM4Mv2 number is a fixed-validation proxy under a non-compliant warm start; it is not a leaderboard rank.
